description:
Problem: oracle_review_covers() in scripts/check_comment_cleanup_scope.py (about line 1704) authorizes candidate notices when (_oracle_review_run_covers OR _oracle_gate_covers) AND _oracle_verdict_covers. _oracle_review_run_covers trusts a successful check run named oracle-review from the github-actions app, in a run of .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml at the head SHA. That workflow executes the pull request's own copy of the file for pull_request and pull_request_review events. A pull request can therefore produce a run that satisfies the first alternative without the App-bound gate, which also checks unresolved oracle threads and stand-ins. After oracle-review-notify-only-20261025, develop's workflow no longer produces that check: the path is dead for honest pull requests and still forgeable.

Outcome: oracle_review_covers requires _oracle_gate_covers (the latest oracle-gate status from the benchbox-oracle App bot is success) together with the verdict check. _oracle_review_run_covers, _oracle_run_covers and the ORACLE_REVIEW_CHECK and ORACLE_REVIEW_WORKFLOW constants are removed.

Decision gates (stop and report if one fails):
1. Re-read oracle_review_covers on current develop and confirm the OR structure. If it has changed, re-plan.
2. Immutable-base rule: the comment-policy job runs the checker from the pull request's base, so this change applies only to pull requests whose base includes it. List open pull requests that change quality/comment-policy.json and record whether any relied on the oracle-review path. If one does, tell its owner; do not block on it.
3. Confirm _oracle_gate_covers returns on the newest oracle-gate status (the statuses API lists newest first) and requires the benchbox-oracle bot. If not, fix that within this item only if the change is minimal; otherwise stop.

Item guardrails: do not loosen any other check, change the verdict check, or change the policy file schema. The whole-tree comment-policy scan must stay clean.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Close out with make pr-preflight, make pr-open, oracle SHIP on the exact head, then make pr-arm. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001). Every behavior change gets a test that fails on the previous code.
